mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL A WHERE A.BUSI_NO = #{pTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR EXISTS( SELECT * FROM STL_ORDERS C WHERE C.TRADE_ID = #{pTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.ORDER_ID = A.BUSI_NO )
DELETE FROM BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING A WHERE A.BUSI_NO = #{pTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR EXISTS( SELECT * FROM STL_ORDERS C WHERE C.TRADE_ID = #{pTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.ORDER_ID = A.BUSI_NO )
mapper.select:
SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, /*金融产品代码*/ A.FINPROD_TYPE, /*金融产品类型*/ coalesce(A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME) as FINPROD_NAME, /*金融产品名称*/ A.PROFIT_TYPE, /*收益类型*/
D.TERM_TYPE AS TERM_TYPE /*期限品种*/
FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID
WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} UNION ALL SELECT B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID, /*科目代码*/ B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE, /*科目类型*/ coalesce(B.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME, B.ACCT_SUBJECT_FULLNAME), /*金融产品名称*/ NULL AS PROFIT_TYPE, /*收益类型*/ NULL AS TERM_TYPE FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO B WHERE B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE IN ('F18','F26') AND B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{finprodId} AND B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{finprodType} UNION ALL SELECT C.FINPROD_ID, /*金融产品代码*/ C.FINPROD_TYPE, /*金融产品类型*/ C.FINPROD_ID, /*金融产品名称*/ C.PROFIT_TYPE, /*收益类型*/ C.TERM_TYPE /*期限品种*/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT C WHERE C.BRANCH = 0 AND C.FINPROD_TYPE != 'F21' AND C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND C.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

select t.* from( SELECT A.FINPROD_ID,A.FINPROD_TYPE,row_number() over() as rownum FROM FIN_PRODUCT A left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID where B.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolidId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and A.P_FINPROD_ID is null
) t where t.rownum = 1
